signal: Snapsheet raised a $30M Series E2 led by Ping An Global Voyager and signed Aspire General Insurance, scaling its cloud-native claims management platform

email.body1:
Eric, saw Snapsheet closed the $30M Series E2 and landed Aspire General Insurance.

Growth and new logos that fast usually mean more in-market carriers and MGAs than the team can personally cover, and that is where pipeline leaks before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Snapsheet off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up for Snapsheet.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Snapsheet needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for Snapsheet.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Snapsheet's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Eric, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Snapsheet either way.
